0022600149.text: The Atlanta Hawks (3-3, 1st in the Southeast, 6th in the East, on a W1 streak) visit the New Orleans Pelicans (1-4, 5th in the Southwest, 14th in the West, also on a W1 streak) in the 7th game of the 2026-27 season for Atlanta. Atlanta is 2-1 on the road and New Orleans is 1-2 at home, and the teams have not met yet this season, after the Hawks won 2025-26 2-0, including a 117-100 win in Atlanta on January 7, 2026. Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while New Orleans is without Jordan Poole (ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (knee bruise).
